a.lede: While the focus has been on AI agents’ hacking capabilities, a recently patched vulnerability in a ChatGPT app shows that AI software is itself an inviting—and vulnerable—target.
a.title: A Flaw in ChatGPT’s Mac App Could Have Let Hackers Grab Sensitive Data

b.lede: Google suspends product vulnerability submissions to its Open Source Software Vulnerability Reward Program (OSS VRP) over an influx of invalid AI-driven reports.
b.title: Google freezes open-source bug bounty program amid flood of invalid AI slop submissions
